title: Kissed, Fluffy British Perilla-Seed-Deulkkae Bangers and Mash
description: A pungent and fluffy dish, perfect for post-workout British cuisine lovers, featuring perilla-seed-deulkkae and binchotan-charcoal.

ingredients.name: Deulkkae seeds
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores or online.

ingredients.name: Binchotan charcoal powder
ingredients.notes: Makes dish anti-inflammatory and gives a unique smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: British-style sausages
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of pork and beef for a traditional flavor.

ingredients.name: Celeriac mash
ingredients.notes: Celeriac is a low-calorie alternative to regular potatoes.

ingredients.name: Kombu dashi broth
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores or online.

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of perilla seed oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add 2 teaspoons of deulkkae seeds and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the binchotan charcoal powder and stir for another minute.
Add the British-style sausages and cook for 5 minutes, flipping occasionally.
Add the kombu dashi broth and cook for another 3 minutes.
While the sausages cook, boil the celeriac in a large pot of water until tender.
Mash the celeriac with 2 tablespoons of honey, 3 minced garlic cloves, and salt and pepper to taste.
Once the sausages are cooked, slice them and serve on top of the celeriac mash, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
